patches.behavior: REGI2C/I2C_MST analog master at 0x6000E000-0x6000E0FF as a timed SEQUENCING engine: parallel engine words +0x00/+0x04 (BIT25 busy self-clears after divider-derived I2C wire time, func 0/1), analog-slave config register FILE (RMW read-back incl. bootloader early-boot slave 0x69 reg 7), SAR2/PWDT phase sequencer (+0x50/0x5c/0x60, FIFO +0x80..+0x9c) armed by the SENS force pair, TX-DC +0x4c timed op, TSENS 0x60008850 dump_out/ready. FAIL-CLOSED: SAR2 words / TSENS sample / TX-DC done require a measurement provider (QOM link meas-provider, interface esp32s3-regi2c-meas-provider); absence reports the exact dependency once and pauses the VM via main-BH vm_stop(RUN_STATE_PAUSED) BEFORE firmware consumption -- no DONE+0, no filler values, no automatic resume. regi2c_wifi_analog_modeled=false: no analog/radio data model exists.

patches.name: 0004-hw-misc-esp32s3_regi2c-model-BBPLL_CAL_DONE-0x40-BIT.patch
patches.behavior: BBPLL_CAL_DONE (0x6000E040 BIT24, I2C_MST_ANA_CONF0) as TIMED ENGINE STATUS, superseding the temporary coreclk read-only bridge (coreclk 0007): clk_ll_bbpll_calibration_start pattern (STOP_FORCE_HIGH BIT2 clear + STOP_FORCE_LOW BIT3 set, two RMW steps) clears BIT24 and starts a modeled 40 us calibration window (true duration UNKNOWN, bounded; completion is engine STATUS, not data -- no provider needed); clk_ll_bbpll_calibration_stop leaves it set until the next start (recalib re-runs); reset leaves it clear (no constant DONE). Verified on the combined profile (coreclk 0001-0005 + this patch, 0007 dropped): from-reset write trace shows start (0x6000e040 <- 0x0, <- 0x8), BBPLL config RMWs (slave 0x66), then calibration_stop reading back the modeled DONE=1 (0x6000e040 <- 0x1000000); boot smoke 3/3. Without this patch that profile spins in the poll (coreclk evidence).
